text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A proposal! Won'tcha help me host a 
farming experience event?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, while I was tending the fields with 
Katsuragi Ace, Chairwoman Akikawa suddenly 
appeared and spoke.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As you all know, the fields are now widely 
open for all students to use!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
So, I would like to borrow the wisdom and 
techniques of you who have successfully 
grown so many crops—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I want you to share it with the other 
Umamusume by all means!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, if that's the case, I've got no 
reason to refuse. Let's do this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up helping out with an 
agricultural experience event for students 
alongside Katsuragi Ace, but...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... Maybe messing around 
in the dirt will help change their mood.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Nah, there're just a few people I'd like 
to invite. ...Would it be alright if I 
went and asked them?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded to say of course, and decided to 
follow Katsuragi Ace. And once thereâtwo 
Umamusume were waiting.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...So that's why I ended up helping out 
with the farming experience.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you guys join in too if you'd 
like? I think it'd be a great change of 
pace!

text_block_list.name: Worrywart Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "A farming experience, huh... ...Hmm—"

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. It's not that I'm not 
interested, but... ...I just don't have 
the room for it right now."

text_block_list.name: Worrywart Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah…… It's our third year, after all. 
Everyone around us is amazing, and I guess 
I don't really have time to get 
sidetracked…… Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, got it. Well then... good luck with 
your training, both of you! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's class entered their third 
year, the Senior Year. As Mr. C.B. and 
Symboli Rudolf loomed ever larger in 
presence—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can understand their feeling that they 
can't afford to stand still.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, yeah. Sorry for dragging you along, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, others'll definitely show up anyway! 
Let's just give it our all for their sake!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the farming experience 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah~! Spider! Spider!! I don't taste 
good at aaaaall~~!! Go find someone 
eeeeeelse~~~...!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san, spiders don't eat 
Umamusume. Let's scoop it up with a trowel 
and set it free.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"T-Turbo's not gonna do it! Nature, you do 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-Why me!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! You guys are as energetic as 
ever～!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still, try to let spiders go if you can. 
After all, spiders are a farmer's best 
friend!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mm? Spiders and a field...? What's that 
supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Check this out, look at this leaf. Not a 
single bug bite on it—clean as can be, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to the spiders eating 
the bugs that chew on the leaves, you see.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Things that look bad at first glance can 
lead to good results, you know. Same 
thing— befriend a spider, and good things 
will happen.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Something good will happen? Really...? 
Hu-huh~ Well then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Not scared, not scared at all...! I'm 
gonna make them best friends with 
Turbo~~...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooo~~~! We did it! We set it free safe 
and sound!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Turbo-san! —And you too, 
Ace-san. Your skill in firing up Turbo-san 
was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, I didn't do anything special. 
As long as everyone has a good time, 
that's what matters most, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Ikuno Dictus said, Twin Turbo's 
behavior changed with just a single word 
from her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has the power to inspire positivity in 
everyone. Just as I was thinking that once 
more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two familiar Umamusume were there. —If I 
remember correctly, they were the 
classmates Katsuragi Ace had invited to 
this farming experience before.

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ………… Looks like fun, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After giving Katsuragi Ace a somewhat 
dazzled look, the two immediately left the 
area.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Staring off into space... Is something 
wrong, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The farming experience concluded without a 
hitch. Perhaps inspired by Katsuragi Ace's 
positive attitude, everyone had a 
refreshed look on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whew, good work today! Quite a crowd 
showed up, huh~!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was a massive hit!
Yeah, it was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, the sowing is done, and it 
looks like the field's gonna be lively 
again!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oh, come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
This fig sapling has gotten pretty big 
too, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If things go well, it should bear fruit 
within the year, right? Heheh, I can't 
wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being with her naturally makes me feel 
positive too. It was thanks to her that 
those words came out so effortlessly.
